## ✨ The first public release

- **A complete shell.** A vertical bar with virtual desktops, open windows, tray, weather and clock, a rounded frame around your windows, and drawers that slide out of the screen edges. Snap, maximise and Win+arrows keep working as usual.
- **Material You colours** taken from your wallpaper, with nine variants, fourteen schemes, and dark and light modes.
- **Dashboard** with calendar, weather, media and synced lyrics, and live CPU, GPU, memory, storage and network gauges.
- **Launcher** for apps, open windows, calculator, emojis, clipboard history and wallpapers. Tap <kbd>Win</kbd> or press <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>Space</kbd>.
- **Notification centre, dynamic island, sound panel, utilities, Alt+Tab switcher and idle screen.**
- **The Stellaria app** installs and repairs the theme, applies colour presets from a signed catalogue, shows the news and brings signed updates, right from the notification area.
- **Safe by design.** The Windows taskbar always comes back, updates are signed, there is no telemetry, and nothing needs administrator rights.
